datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on November 08, 2024
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of November 08, 2024, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20241108]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to delineate actual flood extent polygons resulting from typhoon-induced precipitation and storm surge. The dataset represents post-event observed flood mapping derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and optical satellite data, delivered as vector shapefiles and raster maps to track flood progression.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing and analysis to map actual flood extent from tropical cyclone-induced flooding events
